{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-de-d","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"8c49531c98fc1ba0f757501d1bd4c0f54036aa8bfa46c04778e45bb2e7899cd8","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-de-class-d:lineage:22","source_registry_sha256":"7b6c7aeec232df29a8679bf39181604be2d91ce9a1cb4fcc709fed49cbe724bb","source_liveness_sha256":"53bd779b9965bd9d51630c8d8d055ccdc52a4d8ec7117a3b87241fc5129eb44f"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Class D permits, examinations and medical reporting","heading":"C2 — Class D permits, examinations and medical reporting","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Class D permits, examinations and medical reporting

FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A05
The road-exam applicant must demonstrate merging with traffic. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A05
The road-exam applicant must demonstrate following and overtaking other vehicles. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A05
The road-exam applicant must demonstrate entry into intersections. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A05
The road-exam applicant must demonstrate a vehicle safety inspection and familiarity with vehicle controls. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A05
The road-exam applicant is responsible for providing the vehicle used for the exam. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A05
The road-exam vehicle must belong to the license class for which the applicant applied. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec04-R07 | anchor: A05
The road-exam vehicle must be registered, have liability-insurance proof and satisfy the DMV safety inspection. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec04-R08 | anchor: A06
The examiner performs a basic vehicle safety inspection before the road test starts. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R09 | anchor: A06
Smoking is prohibited during the road exam. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R10 | anchor: A06
Cell-phone use and playing music are prohibited during the road test. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R11 | anchor: A06
An applicant who lacks either a valid Class D license or the legal right to drive alone in Delaware must be accompanied by a licensed driver older than 21, as described on the learner permit. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R12 | anchor: A06
A licensed driver must remain at the examination site so that the vehicle can be driven away if the applicant fails. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R13 | anchor: A06
An applicant should ask the license examiner about anything unclear before the examination. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R14 | anchor: A06
After failing any part of the road examination, an applicant must wait at least 30 days before retesting. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R15 | anchor: A06
The handbook directs applicants to DMV sample driver examinations for practice. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R16 | anchor: A06
Drivers should report health changes that could affect safe driving. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R17 | anchor: A06
A license applicant or renewing driver must declare or document medical conditions that could interfere with safe vehicle operation. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R18 | anchor: A06
The DMV may require a licensed practitioner’s favorable report stating that a medical condition is controlled sufficiently for safe driving. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R19 | anchor: A06
A driver licensed on the basis of a medical report may have to submit a new report every year by the end of the birthday month. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R20 | anchor: A06
Failure to supply a required favorable medical report results in suspension of the driver license. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R21 | anchor: A06
For a medical-report suspension, the DMV requires a $50 reinstatement fee after receiving a favorable medical report. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R22 | anchor: A06
A driver’s immediate family, law enforcement or licensed practitioner may request DMV re-examination of that person’s safe-driving ability. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec04-R23 | anchor: A07
Before issuing a license to a person subject to loss of consciousness or a condition that may impair safe driving, the DMV must receive that person’s licensed practitioner’s MV-346 report stating that the condition is sufficiently controlled for safe driving. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R24 | anchor: A07
The handbook’s August 2024 medical-reporting note encourages licensed practitioners to report patients who may pose a driving danger. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R25 | anchor: A07
A driver may voluntarily surrender a license when unable to obtain a favorable medical report. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R26 | anchor: A07
If a license was voluntarily surrendered before suspension, reinstatement after a favorable medical report carries no reinstatement fee. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R27 | anchor: A07
A license voluntarily surrendered through the medical-surrender process for more than one year requires additional testing before reinstatement. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R28 | anchor: A07
Suspension temporarily removes driving privileges. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R29 | anchor: A07
Revocation cancels driving privileges. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R30 | anchor: A07
Reinstating a suspended license requires a $50 fee. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R31 | anchor: A07
Reinstating a revoked license requires a $200 fee. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R32 | anchor: A07
License reinstatement may require completion of knowledge, road and vision tests. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R33 | anchor: A07
Delaware suspends or revokes a resident’s license for an out-of-state conviction that would justify that action if committed in Delaware. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R34 | anchor: A07
A Delaware driving record includes convictions from other states. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R35 | anchor: A07
A driver licensed under the medical-review report must provide the DMV a new report each year by the end of the driver’s birthday month. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R36 | anchor: A07
The requested re-examination requirements for retaining driving privileges include favorable medical reports and passing the DMV’s vision, knowledge and driving-skills examinations. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec04-R37 | anchor: A07
The requested re-examination process may also require a certified driver-rehabilitation evaluation or training. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0044]
